## Summary
Describe the change and its motivation.

## Scope
- [ ] One focused change
- [ ] No unrelated refactoring
- [ ] No secrets, APKs, proprietary samples or generated private reports committed

## Validation
- [ ] `bash -n scripts/*.sh tests/*.sh`
- [ ] ShellCheck passes
- [ ] Relevant tests pass (include exact commands and actual results)
- [ ] Manual validation performed where applicable (state environment and versions)
- [ ] Documentation links, anchors and diagrams reviewed where changed

## Evidence
List commands executed, environment/release, tool versions and concise sanitized output. Do not claim a test passed unless it ran.

## Security and authorization
Confirm samples are owned or explicitly authorized. Static evidence must not be described as proving an APK safe or malicious.

## Compatibility impact
List affected environments and any untested releases.
